subject: art-design
title: Colour, Pattern, Texture, Space
welcome_lead: The remaining elements that bring artwork to life.
meta_desc: KS3 formal elements: colour, pattern, texture and space.
final_note: These four add the richness and depth.

concepts.def: How a surface feels or looks.
Distance or area in an artwork.
Rubbing pencil over paper on a texture.

walkthroughs.body_html: Pattern is repetition. Patterns appear in nature (zebra stripes), textiles, architecture and design. Repetition with variety holds attention; pure repetition can feel hypnotic.
Try frottage — lay paper over bark or coins and rub a pencil across. This captures actual texture. Drawing fur with tiny lines creates visual texture.
Positive space is the subject. Negative space is what surrounds it. Strong compositions consider both — sometimes the gaps are as interesting as the object.
